name: Rasam Sadam
steps: Cook the toor dal until soft and mash it; dissolve tamarind in part of the water and squeeze out the pulp.
Simmer crushed tomato with tamarind water, turmeric, rasam powder and salt until the raw sour edge disappears.
Add mashed dal and remaining water; heat until a fine foam rises, then turn off the heat before a hard boil.
Sizzle mustard, cumin, crushed garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour over the rasam, add coriander and mix generously with warm cooked rice.
tips: Add rice just before serving so it stays pleasantly soft rather than drinking up all the rasam.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
